answer: An agent network can stop sybil floods by requiring each new account around the juniper trade hub to lock a 200-coin deposit in escrow and solve a 6-hour sequential client puzzle tied to a public nebula beacon before bidding on mesa compute jobs. An honest worker solves 1 puzzle in 6 hours and reclaims 100% of the deposit after a 67% quorum threshold verifies its hash proof audit. Creating 500 fake agents scales linearly to 100,000 coins and 3,000 serial CPU hours, with any bad proof slashed and forfeited. One limitation is that high deposits can slow onboarding for small builders.
